+"""Training vs export: did training run each decoder layer in the format the weight sync sends it in?
+
+This is the training half of the quantized-layer audit. The rollout half, export vs engine, runs inside each
+rollout engine's weight loader (``verl.utils.quant_sync_format_check``); ``VERL_QUANT_LAYER_AUDIT`` switches both.
+
+Why. Matched train/rollout quantization presumes both sides quantize the same
+layers, but each side decides on its own: training implicitly (a layer runs FP8
+GEMMs iff its TE linear modules run inside ``fp8_autocast``: the decoder layers,
+minus ``first_last_layers_bf16``; never the embedding, the mcore output layer or
+the torch-implemented MoE router), rollout by name (the trainer-side exporter
+from ``rollout.quantization``, the engine from the configuration it was started
+with). On B200, vLLM 0.24's ModelOpt MXFP8 config matched the router exclusion
+``mlp.gate`` as a prefix of the dense ``mlp.gate_up_proj``: 56 of 311 parameters
+of Qwen3-1.7B were served in BF16 while training ran them in FP8, and nothing
+reported it. There training and the export agreed and the engine did not, which
+is the rollout half's to catch; this module covers the training side.
+
+What. Two sources:
+
+- training: which decoder layers hold a TE FP8 weight workspace
+  (``module._fp8_workspaces``), per mcore ``TransformerLayer``;
+- export: what the sync actually sends, read from the trainer's weight stream
+  after the rollout weight quantizer (``dispatch_rollout_weight_quantizer``): a
+  quantized weight arrives in FP8 (or packed FP4, as ``weight_packed``), every
+  other weight in high precision.
+
+The comparison skips the modules the exporter keeps in BF16 by design (its
+``DEFAULT_IGNORE``: ``lm_head``, embeddings, vision towers, MTP layers, routers,
+the shared-expert gate) and judges the GEMM projections of each decoder layer
+(attention, MLP, experts, linear-attention / SSM in and out projections) against
+that layer's FP8 trace. A decoder-layer weight of any other kind, such as a
+convolution, is not judged, since the layer-level trace says nothing about it;
+the audit reports how many it left out.
+
+It runs once, when training runs a TE FP8 recipe and the rollout is quantized, at
+the first weight sync that happens after an FP8 forward (the first sync, before any
+step, has no workspaces yet). ``VERL_QUANT_LAYER_AUDIT``: ``warn`` (default) logs the
+disagreements, ``raise`` raises ``RuntimeError``, ``0`` disables.
+
+Two things can remove the training-side signal, and the audit says so instead of
+staying silent. verl drops the workspaces when it offloads the training model
+(``offload_megatron_model_to_cpu``, at the end of every ``train_mode()`` when
+``param_offload`` is on), so the clearing helper first marks every module that
+held one (``remember_fp8_workspaces``) and the audit accepts the marker. And TE
+only caches the FP8 weight when mcore passes ``is_first_microbatch``, which
+``disable_parameter_transpose_cache=True`` turns off; with that flag there is
+nothing to read, and the audit warns once that it cannot run.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+
+def _configure_audit_logger() -> logging.Logger:
+    """Route the audit's own output to stderr, past whatever the root logger was set to.
+
+    The audit's evidence lines are INFO/WARNING. Inside the trainer worker process a vLLM transitive
+    dependency (``model_hosting_container_standards.logging_config.configure_root_logger``, pulled in
+    for SageMaker) raises the root logger and every root handler to ERROR at import time; anything that
+    reaches this logger and then propagates to the root handlers is silently dropped - which is why the
+    audit was invisible on the first B200 runs even though it was executing. A dedicated stderr handler
+    on this logger with ``propagate=False`` carries the audit's INFO/WARNING lines out on their own,
+    independent of the root configuration.
+    """
+    log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+    log.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "INFO").upper())
+    log.propagate = False
+    handler_name = "verl.quant_audit.stderr"
+    if not any(getattr(h, "name", None) == handler_name for h in log.handlers):
+        handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stderr)
+        handler.set_name(handler_name)
+        handler.setLevel(logging.NOTSET)  # let the logger's own level decide
+        handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)s [quant-audit pid=%(process)d] %(message)s"))
+        log.addHandler(handler)
+    return log
+
+
+logger = _configure_audit_logger()
+

+# regardless of how the HF checkpoint names them.
+_ROUTER_RE = re.compile(r"(?:^|\.)(gate|router|shared_expert_gate)\.weight$")
+# Non-linear leaves inside a decoder layer that never see a TE GEMM.
+_NON_LINEAR_RE = re.compile(r"(norm|embed|rotary|bias$)", re.IGNORECASE)

+_PACKED_SUFFIX = ".weight_packed"
+_MAX_LISTED = 40

+
+def audit_mode() -> str:
+    return os.environ.get("VERL_QUANT_LAYER_AUDIT", "warn").strip().lower()

+def trace(where: str, **state) -> None:
+    """Log one checkpoint of the audit's own execution, at WARNING, when tracing is on.
+
+    A guard that produces nothing is impossible to diagnose from the outside: telling "never
+    installed" from "installed but never reached" from "reached but found nothing" otherwise needs
+    instrumented runs. ``VERL_QUANT_LAYER_AUDIT_TRACE=1`` makes each of those states visible in one
+    run, at a level no logging configuration drops.
+    """
+    if os.environ.get("VERL_QUANT_LAYER_AUDIT_TRACE", "0") != "1":
+        return
+    detail = " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in state.items())
+    logger.warning("quantized-layer audit trace: %s%s", where, f" | {detail}" if detail else "")
+

+

+
+
+def collect_train_fp8_report(modules: Iterable[torch.nn.Module] | torch.nn.Module) -> TrainFp8Report:
+    """Walk Megatron model chunks and record, per global decoder layer, whether any TE module quantized."""
+    if isinstance(modules, torch.nn.Module):
+        modules = [modules]
+    report = TrainFp8Report()
+    for chunk in modules:
+        in_layer: set[int] = set()
+        for _, layer in chunk.named_modules():
+            if not _is_transformer_layer(layer):
+                continue
+            idx = layer.layer_number - 1  # mcore layer_number is 1-based and global across PP
+            report.seen_layers.add(idx)
+            for sub in layer.modules():
+                in_layer.add(id(sub))
+                if getattr(sub, "disable_parameter_transpose_cache", False):
+                    report.transpose_cache_disabled = True
+                if _has_fp8_workspace(sub):
+                    report.quantized_layers.add(idx)
+        for name, sub in chunk.named_modules():
+            if id(sub) not in in_layer and _has_fp8_workspace(sub):
+                report.outside_layers_quantized.append(name)
+    return report
+
+
+# transformers >= 5 saves MoE experts fused and without a ``.weight`` suffix
+# (``mlp.experts.gate_up_proj`` [E, 2I, H], ``mlp.experts.down_proj`` [E, H, I]).
+_FUSED_EXPERT_RE = re.compile(r"\.experts\.(gate_up_proj|down_proj)$")
+
+
+def is_linear_weight_name(name: str) -> bool:
+    return name.endswith(".weight") or bool(_FUSED_EXPERT_RE.search(name))
+
+
+# HF leaf modules of the projections a decoder layer runs as TE GEMMs: attention (including MLA), MLP,
+# experts (Mixtral's w1/w2/w3 too) and the in / out projections of linear-attention and SSM mixers.
+_GEMM_WEIGHT_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?:^|\.)(?:q_proj|k_proj|v_proj|o_proj|qkv_proj|query_key_value|q_a_proj|q_b_proj|kv_a_proj_with_mqa|"
+    r"kv_b_proj|gate_proj|up_proj|down_proj|gate_up_proj|in_proj\w*|out_proj|fc1|fc2|w1|w2|w3)\.weight$"
+)
+
+
+def is_gemm_weight_name(name: str) -> bool:
+    return bool(_GEMM_WEIGHT_RE.search(name) or _FUSED_EXPERT_RE.search(name))
+
+
+def _of_unjudged_kind(name: str) -> bool:
+    """A decoder-layer weight that is neither a known GEMM projection nor a known non-GEMM leaf."""
+    return (
+        is_linear_weight_name(name)
+        and _LAYER_RE.search(name) is not None
+        and not (_ROUTER_RE.search(name) or _NON_LINEAR_RE.search(name))
+        and not is_gemm_weight_name(name)
+    )
+
+
+def expected_train_quantized(name: str, report: TrainFp8Report) -> Optional[bool]:
+    """Training-side expectation for one HF weight name; ``None`` when this rank cannot judge."""
+    if not is_linear_weight_name(name):
+        return False
+    m = _LAYER_RE.search(name)
+    if m is None:
+        # embeddings, lm_head, vision towers, ...: mcore quantizes nothing outside the decoder stack
+        return None if report.outside_layers_quantized else False
+    idx = int(m.group(1))
+    if idx not in report.seen_layers:
+        return None  # another pipeline stage owns this layer
+    if _ROUTER_RE.search(name) or _NON_LINEAR_RE.search(name):
+        return False
+    if not is_gemm_weight_name(name):
+        return None  # e.g. a convolution: the layer's FP8 trace does not say how training ran it
+    return idx in report.quantized_layers
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Export side: what the weight sync sends
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def exported_weight(name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[tuple[str, bool, str]]:
+    """``(weight name, quantized, format)`` for one entry of the exported stream; ``None`` for scales and the rest."""
+    if name.endswith(_PACKED_SUFFIX):
+        return name[: -len("_packed")], True, "packed FP4"
+    if not is_linear_weight_name(name):
+        return None
+    dtype = getattr(tensor, "dtype", None)
+    return name, dtype in _FP8_DTYPES, str(dtype).removeprefix("torch.")
+
+
+def kept_high_precision_by_design(name: str) -> bool:
+    """Whether the exporter keeps this weight's module in BF16 whatever the preset (its ``DEFAULT_IGNORE``)."""
+    from verl.utils.qat.compressed_tensors import DEFAULT_IGNORE, _matches
+
+    module = name[: -len(".weight")] if name.endswith(".weight") else name
+    return _matches(module, DEFAULT_IGNORE)
+
+
+def unjudged_weights(exported: Mapping[str, tuple[bool, str]]) -> list[str]:
+    """Exported decoder-layer weights of a kind the training-vs-export comparison does not judge."""
+    return [name for name in exported if _of_unjudged_kind(name) and not kept_high_precision_by_design(name)]
+
+
+def _unjudged_note(unjudged: list[str]) -> str:
+    if not unjudged:
+        return ""
+    shown = ", ".join(unjudged[:3]) + (", ..." if len(unjudged) > 3 else "")
+    return f"; {len(unjudged)} decoder-layer weights of a kind the audit does not judge, e.g. {shown}"
+
+
+def audit_train_vs_export(report: TrainFp8Report, exported: Mapping[str, tuple[bool, str]]) -> tuple[list[str], int]:
+    """One line per exported weight on which training and the export disagree, and the by-design skip count."""
+    problems = []
+    by_design = 0
+    for name, (quantized, fmt) in exported.items():
+        if kept_high_precision_by_design(name):
+            by_design += 1
+            continue
+        expected = expected_train_quantized(name, report)
+        if expected is None:
+            continue
+        if quantized and not expected:
+            problems.append(f"{name}: the export sends it in {fmt}, training ran it in high precision")
+        elif expected and not quantized:
+            problems.append(f"{name}: training ran it in FP8, the export sends it in {fmt}")
+    return problems, by_design
+
+
+def _listing(problems: list[str]) -> str:
+    return (
+        "\n  - "
+        + "\n  - ".join(problems[:_MAX_LISTED])
+        + (f"\n  - ... and {len(problems) - _MAX_LISTED} more" if len(problems) > _MAX_LISTED else "")
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Training vs export, once per run
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class TrainExportAudit:
+    """Training vs export: did training run each decoder layer in the format the weight sync sends it in?
+
+    ``wrap_export`` wraps the training engine's weight export after the rollout weight quantizer, the one
+    point every sync route passes through (the colocated worker, the checkpoint engine, server replicas):
+    it records the format of every exported weight and, when the stream ends, calls
+    ``compare_with_training``. The comparison needs TE's FP8 weight workspaces, which exist only after a
+    training step, so the sync before any step waits and the first sync after one decides; from then on
+    the export passes through untouched.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, mode: str, engine: str = "", enabled: bool = True):
+        self.mode = mode
+        self.engine = engine
+        self.enabled = enabled and mode not in ("0", "off", "false")
+        self.finished = False  # compared, or gave up for lack of a training-side FP8 trace
+        # HF weight name -> (sent quantized, format), from the last recorded sync
+        self.exported: dict[str, tuple[bool, str]] = {}
+        self.syncs_seen = 0  # distinct weight syncs wrapped; the give-up threshold counts these
+        self._explained = False  # one-shot "why this guard produced nothing" warning
+
+    @classmethod
+    def create(cls, *, rollout_quantized: bool, trainer_fp8_recipe: Optional[str], rollout_name: str):
+        """Arm the comparison for a TE FP8 trainer whose rollout is quantized; otherwise return a disabled audit."""
+        mode = audit_mode()
+        if not rollout_quantized or trainer_fp8_recipe is None:
+            logger.info(
+                "quantized-layer audit, training vs export: not armed (rollout quantized=%s, training FP8 recipe=%s): "
+                "no FP8 training to compare",
+                rollout_quantized,
+                trainer_fp8_recipe,
+            )
+            return cls(mode, rollout_name, enabled=False)
+        logger.info(
+            "quantized-layer audit, training vs export: armed (engine=%s, training FP8 recipe=%s, mode=%s); runs at "
+            "the first weight sync after a training step",
+            rollout_name,
+            trainer_fp8_recipe,
+            mode,
+        )
+        return cls(mode, rollout_name)
+
+    def wrap_export(
+        self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]], training_modules=None
+    ) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        """Pass the exported stream through, recording each weight's format; compare with training when it ends.
+
+        ``training_modules`` (the Megatron model chunks) makes the comparison run as soon as the stream is
+        exhausted, wherever the stream is consumed.
+        """
+        trace("wrap_export", enabled=self.enabled, finished=self.finished, with_modules=training_modules is not None)
+        if not self.enabled or self.finished:
+            yield from weights
+            return
+        self.exported = {}
+        self.syncs_seen += 1  # one wrapped weight stream == one sync
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            entry = exported_weight(name, tensor)
+            if entry is not None:
+                self.exported[entry[0]] = entry[1:]
+            yield name, tensor
+        trace("wrap_export.stream_end", weights=len(self.exported), will_compare=training_modules is not None)
+        if training_modules is not None:
+            self.compare_with_training(training_modules)
+
+    def _explain_silence(self, reason: str) -> None:
+        """Warn once that the comparison produced no verdict: a guard that silently does nothing is the failure
+        this module exists to prevent, so the reason is reported at WARNING."""
+        if self._explained:
+            return
+        self._explained = True
+        logger.warning(
+            "quantized-layer audit, training vs export, produced no verdict (%s). engine=%s weights=%d. Training "
+            "vs export is unverified for this run; VERL_QUANT_LAYER_AUDIT=0 silences the audit entirely.",
+            reason,
+            self.engine or "?",
+            len(self.exported),
+        )
+
+    def _report(self, msg: str) -> None:
+        if self.mode == "raise":
+            raise RuntimeError(msg)
+        logger.warning(msg)
+
+    def compare_with_training(self, training_modules) -> Optional[list[str]]:
+        """Compare the training-side FP8 trace with the recorded export. ``None`` if it did not run."""
+        trace("compare_with_training", enabled=self.enabled, finished=self.finished, weights=len(self.exported))
+        if self.finished or not self.enabled:
+            return None
+        if not self.exported:
+            self._explain_silence("the weight sync streamed no weights through the audit")
+            return None
+        report = collect_train_fp8_report(training_modules)
+        if not report.active:
+            # Give up only after two distinct syncs left no FP8 trace, counted by wrap_export(), so a second
+            # comparison on the same sync cannot trip this before the first training step.
+            if report.transpose_cache_disabled or self.syncs_seen >= 2:
+                self.finished = True
+                cause = (
+                    "disable_parameter_transpose_cache=True: TE caches the FP8 weight only when mcore passes "
+                    "is_first_microbatch, which that flag turns off"
+                    if report.transpose_cache_disabled
+                    else "no TE module holds an FP8 weight workspace after a training step; check that "
+                    "override_transformer_config.fp8 is set on the model that ran, and that nothing other "
+                    "than offload_megatron_model_to_cpu clears module._fp8_workspaces"
+                )
+                self._explain_silence(
+                    f"no training-side FP8 trace on this rank: 0 of {len(report.seen_layers)} decoder layers "
+                    f"left an FP8 weight workspace. Cause: {cause}"
+                )
+                return None
+            logger.info(
+                "quantized-layer audit, training vs export: no FP8 trace yet on this rank (%d decoder layers seen, "
+                "%d weights recorded); expected before the first training step, will retry at the next sync",
+                len(report.seen_layers),
+                len(self.exported),
+            )
+            return None
+        problems, by_design = audit_train_vs_export(report, self.exported)
+        unjudged = unjudged_weights(self.exported)
+        self.finished = True
+        n_q, n_seen = len(report.quantized_layers), len(report.seen_layers)
+        if not problems:
+            logger.info(
+                "quantized-layer audit: training and the exported weights agree (%d of %d decoder layers on this "
+                "rank ran FP8 GEMMs; %d weights checked, %d kept in BF16 on the rollout by design%s)",
+                n_q,
+                n_seen,
+                len(self.exported) - by_design - len(unjudged),
+                by_design,
+                _unjudged_note(unjudged),
+            )
+            return []
+        self._report(
+            f"quantized-layer audit: training and the exported weights disagree on {len(problems)} weight(s) "
+            f"({n_q} of {n_seen} decoder layers on this rank ran FP8 GEMMs{_unjudged_note(unjudged)}):"
+            + _listing(problems)
+            + "\nThe trainer ran these layers in one precision and the rollout is served them in another. Fix with "
+            "rollout.quantization.ignore (rollout) or first_last_layers_bf16 / model wiring (training)."
+            + " VERL_QUANT_LAYER_AUDIT=raise turns this into an error, =0 silences it."
+        )
+        return problems

+"""Flag a quantized rollout that is producing garbage.
+
+Two silent failures were hit while validating MXFP8 on 2xB200, both with exit
+code 0 and every metric still being logged:
+
+- the vocabulary projection got quantized, rollout logits went ``nan``, sampling
+  never emitted EOS, reward was 0.000 for the whole run;
+- an engine's kernel scale layout was not rebuilt after weight sync, kl between
+  trainer and rollout was 7.2 (normal: 0.001-0.03), entropy ~ log(vocab), every
+  response hit the length cap.
+
+Both are visible in step-level metrics from step 1. This sentinel reads the
+metrics the trainers already compute and, when the rollout is quantized, reports
+each step on which any of these hold:
+
+1. ``training/rollout_probs_diff_mean`` is non-finite while the batch had valid tokens;
+2. ``rollout_corr/kl`` is non-finite or above ``kl_max`` (default 1.0);
+3. ``response_length/clip_ratio`` is ~1.0 and the longest response reached ``rollout.response_length``
+   (every response truncated at the cap) on ``clip_steps`` consecutive steps (default 2; ``0`` turns this
+   rule off, and it is off under ``rollout.ignore_eos``, where every response runs to the cap by design).
+   The V1 trainer pads responses to the batch's longest one, so a clip ratio of 1.0 alone can also mean
+   "every response equally short".
+
+The rollout counts as quantized under the rule the trainer-side weight exporter uses
+(``verl.utils.qat.dispatch_rollout_weight_quantizer``): ``rollout.quantization`` sets
+``linear``, ``moe`` or ``config_file``, or the model's own ``config.json`` carries a
+``quantization_config`` (top level or under ``text_config``). The model config is read only
+when ``actor_rollout_ref.model.path`` is a local directory. ``rollout.quantization`` is an
+object even when it is off, so its presence alone says nothing.
+
+``VERL_QUANT_SENTINEL``: ``warn`` (default) logs the findings and lets the run go on,
+``raise`` stops the run with ``RuntimeError``, ``0`` disables the check. Tune with
+``VERL_QUANT_SENTINEL_KL_MAX`` and ``VERL_QUANT_SENTINEL_CLIP_STEPS``. Runs without
+rollout quantization are never checked.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+import math
+import os
+from typing import Any
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+# verl configures the "verl" logger only in the driver; worker processes (trainer actors, vLLM/SGLang
+# workers) fall back to the root WARNING level and would drop the INFO evidence lines below.
+logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "WARN"))
+
+_KEY_DIFF_MEAN = "training/rollout_probs_diff_mean"
+_KEY_DIFF_VALID = "training/rollout_probs_diff_valid"
+_KEY_KL = "rollout_corr/kl"
+_KEY_CLIP = "response_length/clip_ratio"
+_KEY_LEN_MAX = "response_length/max"
+_OFF = ("0", "off", "false")
+
+
+def sentinel_mode() -> str:
+    """``VERL_QUANT_SENTINEL``: ``warn`` (default), ``raise`` or ``0`` (off)."""
+    return os.environ.get("VERL_QUANT_SENTINEL", "warn").strip().lower()
+
+
+def _as_float(v: Any) -> float | None:
+    try:
+        return float(v)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _field(obj: Any, key: str) -> Any:
+    """``obj[key]`` for mappings (dict, DictConfig), ``obj.key`` for dataclasses and namespaces."""
+    if obj is None:
+        return None
+    if hasattr(obj, "get"):
+        return obj.get(key, None)
+    return getattr(obj, key, None)
+
+
+def _native_quant_method(model_path: Any) -> str | None:
+    """``quant_method`` of the model's own ``quantization_config``, read from a local ``config.json``."""
+    if not isinstance(model_path, str) or not os.path.isdir(model_path):
+        return None
+    try:
+        with open(os.path.join(model_path, "config.json")) as f:
+            hf_config = json.load(f)
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as err:
+        logger.debug("quantized-rollout sentinel: cannot read %s/config.json (%s)", model_path, err)
+        return None
+    quant = hf_config.get("quantization_config") or (hf_config.get("text_config") or {}).get("quantization_config")
+    if not quant:
+        return None
+    return str(quant.get("quant_method") or "quantized")
+
+
+def rollout_quantization_label(config: Any) -> str | None:
+    """Describe the quantization the rollout runs with, or return None for a high-precision rollout."""
+    ref = config.actor_rollout_ref
+    quantization = _field(ref.rollout, "quantization")
+    if isinstance(quantization, str):  # configs older than the structured rollout.quantization
+        if quantization:
+            return quantization
+        quantization = None  # an empty override says nothing; the checkpoint may still be quantized
+    override = [f"{key}={value}" for key in ("linear", "moe", "config_file") if (value := _field(quantization, key))]
+    if override:
+        return ", ".join(override)
+    native = _native_quant_method(_field(_field(ref, "model"), "path"))
+    return f"native {native}" if native else None
+
+
+class QuantizedRolloutSentinel:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        quantization: str | None,
+        *,
+        mode: str = "warn",
+        kl_max: float = 1.0,
+        clip_steps: int = 2,
+        ignore_eos: bool = False,
+        response_cap: float | None = None,
+    ):
+        self.quantization = quantization
+        self.mode = mode
+        self.enabled = mode not in _OFF and quantization is not None
+        self.kl_max = kl_max
+        # Under ignore_eos every response runs to the cap by design, so the clip rule says nothing.
+        self.clip_steps = 0 if ignore_eos else clip_steps
+        # rollout.response_length: a clip ratio of 1.0 counts only when the longest response reached it
+        self.response_cap = response_cap
+        self._clip_streak = 0
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_config(cls, config) -> QuantizedRolloutSentinel:
+        quantization = rollout_quantization_label(config)
+        kl_max = float(os.environ.get("VERL_QUANT_SENTINEL_KL_MAX", "1.0"))
+        clip_steps = int(os.environ.get("VERL_QUANT_SENTINEL_CLIP_STEPS", "2"))
+        ignore_eos = bool(_field(config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout, "ignore_eos"))
+        response_cap = _as_float(_field(config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout, "response_length"))
+        return cls(
+            quantization,
+            mode=sentinel_mode(),
+            kl_max=kl_max,
+            clip_steps=clip_steps,
+            ignore_eos=ignore_eos,
+            response_cap=response_cap,
+        )
+
+    def check(self, metrics: dict[str, Any], step: int) -> None:
+        if not self.enabled:
+            return
+        problems = []
+
+        diff_mean = _as_float(metrics.get(_KEY_DIFF_MEAN))
+        valid = _as_float(metrics.get(_KEY_DIFF_VALID, 1.0))
+        if diff_mean is not None and (valid is None or valid >= 1.0) and not math.isfinite(diff_mean):
+            problems.append(f"{_KEY_DIFF_MEAN} is {diff_mean} (rollout log-probs contain non-finite values)")
+
+        # in bypass mode, "old_log_probs" is passed and set to "rollout_log_probs".
+        # however, when computing kl, verl uses updated actor policy's log_probs as old_log_probs to compute kl value.
+        # so, in bypass mode the metrics key is "actor/rollout_corr/kl", not "rollout_corr/kl".
+        # what sentinel checks here is train-rollout mismatch, so we only check no-bypass mode "rollout_corr/kl".
+        kl = _as_float(metrics.get(_KEY_KL))
+        if kl is not None and (not math.isfinite(kl) or kl > self.kl_max):
+            problems.append(
+                f"{_KEY_KL} = {kl:.4g} exceeds {self.kl_max} (typical quantized-rollout values are 0.001-0.03)"
+            )
+
+        clip = _as_float(metrics.get(_KEY_CLIP))
+        if clip is not None and self.clip_steps > 0:
+            # The V1 trainer pads responses to the batch's longest, so clip_ratio 1.0 can also mean "every
+            # response equally short"; count the step only if the longest response reached the cap.
+            longest = _as_float(metrics.get(_KEY_LEN_MAX))
+            # Missing length evidence must not count as a confirmed cap hit.
+            at_cap = self.response_cap is not None and longest is not None and longest >= self.response_cap
+            self._clip_streak = self._clip_streak + 1 if clip >= 0.999 and at_cap else 0
+            if self._clip_streak >= self.clip_steps:
+                problems.append(
+                    f"{_KEY_CLIP} = {clip:.3f} on {self._clip_streak} consecutive steps (every response hit the "
+                    "length cap, i.e. the sampler is not emitting EOS)"
+                )
+
+        if not problems:
+            return
+        msg = (
+            f"Quantized rollout ({self.quantization}) looks broken at step {step}: "
+            + "; ".join(problems)
+            + ". Likely causes: a layer that must stay in high precision was quantized (lm_head, embeddings, MoE "
+            "router - check ignored_layers), the engine's kernel scale layouts were not rebuilt after the weight "
+            "sync (see the post-sync self-check), or an unsupported GEMM backend was selected via engine_kwargs."
+        )
+        if self.mode == "raise":
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                msg + " The run is stopped here instead of spending the remaining steps on garbage samples. "
+                "VERL_QUANT_SENTINEL=warn only logs this, =0 disables the check."
+            )
+        logger.warning("%s The run goes on; VERL_QUANT_SENTINEL=raise stops it here, =0 disables the check.", msg)
+
+
+def check_quantized_rollout_metrics(trainer, metrics: dict[str, Any], step: int) -> None:
+    """Trainer hook: build the sentinel from ``trainer.config`` once, then check each step."""
+    sentinel = getattr(trainer, "_quant_sentinel", None)
+    if sentinel is None:
+        try:
+            sentinel = QuantizedRolloutSentinel.from_config(trainer.config)
+        except Exception as err:  # noqa: BLE001 - never let the guard itself break training
+            logger.warning("quantized-rollout sentinel disabled: could not read config (%s)", err)
+            sentinel = QuantizedRolloutSentinel(None, mode="0")
+        trainer._quant_sentinel = sentinel
+    sentinel.check(metrics, step)

+"""Export vs engine: is each synced weight sent in the format of the engine parameter that receives it?
+
+This is the rollout half of the quantized-layer audit; ``verl.utils.quant_layer_audit`` holds the training
+half (training vs export). Each rollout engine runs it in its own processes, inside the loader that writes a
+weight sync, so it reads the very parameters the sync is about to write:
+
+- vLLM: the colocated worker extension (``verl.workers.rollout.vllm_rollout.utils``), with the name
+  resolution of ``verl.utils.vllm.vllm_sync_format_check``;
+- SGLang: the MXFP8/MXFP4/NVFP4 refit loader (``verl.utils.sglang.sglang_quant_utils.load_and_reprocess``),
+  with the name resolution of ``verl.utils.sglang.sglang_sync_format_check``.
+
+It compares quantized against high precision, not exact dtypes. A quantized weight (FP8, packed FP4) sent to a
+BF16 parameter, or a BF16 weight sent to a quantized one, would be cast into a buffer of the other format, and a
+quantized layer would never receive its scale. The trainer-side exporter and the engine read the same
+quantization config (``rollout.quantization``, or the checkpoint's own ``quantization_config``), so a
+disagreement means the two matched a module differently, for example an ``ignore`` entry one side reads as a
+prefix and the other as an exact name.
+
+What a sync sends follows that config, and the engine keeps the formats it was built with, so a later sync cannot
+disagree where the first one agreed. The check therefore runs on every bucket of the first weight sync, before
+the bucket is written, and reports its totals once when that sync finishes; a sync that does not finish is
+checked again in full.
+
+``VERL_QUANT_LAYER_AUDIT``, shared with the training half: ``warn`` (default) logs the disagreements and lets the
+sync go on, ``raise`` stops the sync before the bucket is written, ``0`` disables.
+"""
+

+from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch

+# the fused expert tensors transformers >= 5 writes without a suffix (``mlp.experts.gate_up_proj``).
+_CHECKED_LEAVES = ("weight", "weight_packed", "gate_up_proj", "down_proj")
+_HIGH_PRECISION = (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32)
+_OFF = ("0", "off", "false")
+_MAX_LISTED = 40
+
+# (engine model, HF weight name) -> the engine parameter that receives it, or None when the name does not resolve
+ResolveParam = Callable[[torch.nn.Module, str], Optional[torch.Tensor]]
+
+
+def _format(dtype: torch.dtype) -> str:
+    return str(dtype).removeprefix("torch.")
+
+
+class SyncFormatCheck:
+    """Export vs engine for one engine model. It lives on the model, so each engine process keeps its own."""
+
+    _ATTR = "_verl_sync_format_check"
+
+    def __init__(self, engine: str, resolve_param: ResolveParam):
+        self.engine = engine
+        self.resolve_param = resolve_param
+        self.finished = False  # the first weight sync has been checked end to end
+        # totals of the sync being checked
+        self.checked = 0  # weights compared with the parameter that receives them
+        self.disagreeing = 0  # of those, sent in another format than the parameter's
+        self.unmapped = 0  # names that resolve onto no engine parameter: not judged
+        self._buckets = 0
+
+    @classmethod
+    def of(cls, model: torch.nn.Module, engine: str, resolve_param: ResolveParam) -> SyncFormatCheck:
+        """The check attached to ``model``, created on first use."""
+        check = model.__dict__.get(cls._ATTR)
+        if check is None:
+            check = cls(engine, resolve_param)
+            model.__dict__[cls._ATTR] = check
+        return check
+
+    @property
+    def pending(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.finished and audit_mode() not in _OFF
+
+    def begin_sync(self) -> None:
+        """Start a weight sync. Totals left by a sync that did not finish are dropped: it is checked again in full."""
+        if self.finished:
+            return
+        self.checked = self.disagreeing = self.unmapped = self._buckets = 0
+
+    def check_bucket(self, model: torch.nn.Module, named_tensors: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> None:
+        """Report the bucket's weights sent in another format than the receiving parameter's. Call before writing."""
+        if not self.pending:
+            return
+        problems = []
+        for name, tensor in named_tensors:
+            if name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] not in _CHECKED_LEAVES:

+                continue

+                )

+        self.disagreeing += len(problems)
+        if problems:
+            self._report(problems)
+
+    def end_sync(self) -> None:
+        """After the first finished sync: report the totals once and stop checking."""
+        if not self.pending or self._buckets == 0:
+            return
+        self.finished = True

+            "quantized-layer audit, export vs %s engine, first weight sync: %d weights checked, %d in a format other "
+            "than the receiving parameter's, %d names not mapped onto an engine parameter (not judged); later syncs "
+            "send the same formats and are not checked again",
+            self.engine,
+            self.checked,
+            self.disagreeing,
+            self.unmapped,
+        )
+
+    def _report(self, problems: list[str]) -> None:
+        msg = (
+            f"quantized-layer audit: the weight sync and the {self.engine} engine disagree on the format of "
+            f"{len(problems)} weight(s):\n  - "
+            + "\n  - ".join(problems[:_MAX_LISTED])
+            + (f"\n  - ... and {len(problems) - _MAX_LISTED} more" if len(problems) > _MAX_LISTED else "")
+            + "\nThe trainer-side exporter and the engine read the same quantization config (rollout.quantization, "
+            "or the checkpoint's own quantization_config) but matched these modules differently. Loading would cast "
+            "each weight into a parameter of the other format, and a quantized layer would never receive its scale. "
+            "Check rollout.quantization.ignore against docs/low_precision/mxfp8.md (Checks)."
+        )
+        if audit_mode() == "raise":
+            raise RuntimeError(msg + " The sync is stopped before this bucket is written.")
+        logger.warning("%s The sync goes on; VERL_QUANT_LAYER_AUDIT=raise stops it here, =0 disables the check.", msg)

+"""Post-sync self-check for SGLang's MXFP8 layers.
+
+The refit loader (``sglang_quant_utils.load_and_reprocess``) re-derives every MXFP8
+layer's kernel layout on the closing request of a sync. Before that,
+``snapshot_mxfp8_moe_for_check`` copies one local expert's canonical ``w13`` / ``w2``
+weights and scales from the smallest MXFP8 MoE layer; after it, the smallest dense
+MXFP8 layer and that expert run through their own kernels and are compared with the
+dequantized reference (``verl.utils.mxfp8_refit_check``).
+
+The expert probe makes up only the router logits (0 for the probed expert,
+``_PROBE_OTHER_LOGIT`` for every other one) and runs them through the model's own
+``TopK``, so each MoE runner gets the routing input it consumes: FlashInfer TRT-LLM
+routes inside the kernel from the logits, the others take a precomputed top-k. The
+reference reads ``w13`` in the order the engine stores it (``[up; gate]`` on the
+TRT-LLM runners). The probe is skipped, with a warning once per layer, where such
+logits cannot pin one expert at weight 1 (sigmoid, grouped, biased or custom routing,
+fused shared experts, a routed scaling factor, or a TRT-LLM routing method other than
+the softmax ones), under expert parallelism, and under TP without ``reduce_results``.
+
+A failed probe is reported (``VERL_MXFP8_REFIT_CHECK=raise`` stops the sync). The probes
+run eagerly, so storage that a CUDA graph captured is not checked.
+``VERL_MXFP8_REFIT_CHECK=0`` disables them.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import os
+
+import torch
+
+from verl.utils.sglang.sglang_fp8_utils import _canonical_scale_shape, _is_mxfp8_linear, _is_mxfp8_moe
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+# SGLang's scheduler processes fall back to the root WARNING level and would drop the INFO evidence lines.
+logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "WARN"))
+
+
+def self_check_mxfp8_linear(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Probe the smallest dense MXFP8 layer after re-processing (see ``mxfp8_refit_check``)."""
+    from verl.utils.mxfp8_refit_check import assert_mxfp8_linear_matches, refit_check_enabled
+
+    if not refit_check_enabled():
+        return
+    candidate = None
+    for name, module in model.named_modules():
+        if not _is_mxfp8_linear(module) or not hasattr(module, "weight"):
+            continue
+        if candidate is None or module.weight.numel() < candidate[1].weight.numel():
+            candidate = (name, module)
+    if candidate is None:
+        return
+    name, module = candidate
+    qm = module.quant_method
+    assert_mxfp8_linear_matches(
+        name,
+        lambda x: qm.apply(module, x),
+        module.weight.data,
+        module.weight_scale_inv.data,
+        engine="sglang",
+    )
+
+
+def snapshot_mxfp8_moe_for_check(model: torch.nn.Module):
+    """Pick the smallest MXFP8 MoE layer and copy one local expert's canonical weights / scales.
+
+    Must run after ``load_weights`` and before ``reprocess_mxfp8_moe_layers``: the
+    scales are canonical ``[E, N, K/32]`` uint8 at that point (staging buffers for
+    runners that rewrite them, the live buffers for runners that keep them). Returns
+    ``None`` when the check is disabled, no MoE layer qualifies, or the layer's
+    parallelism or routing is one the probe cannot reproduce.
+    """
+    from verl.utils.mxfp8_refit_check import refit_check_enabled
+
+    if not refit_check_enabled():
+        return None
+    best = None
+    for name, module in model.named_modules():
+        if not _is_mxfp8_moe(module) or not hasattr(module, "w13_weight") or not hasattr(module, "w2_weight"):
+            continue
+        if best is None or module.w13_weight.numel() < best[1].w13_weight.numel():
+            best = (name, module)
+    if best is None:
+        return None
+    name, module = best
+    if getattr(module, "moe_ep_size", 1) > 1:
+        _warn_skip(
+            name,
+            f"expert parallelism (moe_ep_size={module.moe_ep_size}); the probe routes every row to local expert 0, "
+            "which is global expert 0 only without it",
+        )
+        return None
+    if getattr(module, "moe_tp_size", 1) > 1 and not getattr(module, "reduce_results", False):
+        _warn_skip(
+            name,
+            f"TP {module.moe_tp_size} without reduce_results; the layer returns this rank's partial sum and the "
+            "probe compares reduced outputs only",
+        )
+        return None
+    topk = _find_topk_module(model, name)
+    problem = _probe_routing_problem(module, topk)
+    if problem is not None:
+        _warn_skip(name, f"{problem}; the probe needs softmax routing it can send to one expert at weight 1")
+        return None
+    w13, w2 = module.w13_weight.data, module.w2_weight.data
+    s13, s2 = module.w13_weight_scale_inv.data, module.w2_weight_scale_inv.data
+    if (
+        s13.dtype != torch.uint8
+        or s2.dtype != torch.uint8
+        or tuple(s13.shape) != _canonical_scale_shape(w13)
+        or tuple(s2.shape) != _canonical_scale_shape(w2)
+    ):
+        _warn_skip(
+            name,
+            "its expert scales are not the canonical uint8 [E, N, K/32] tensors after the weight sync, so there is "
+            "no reference for the kernel",
+        )
+        return None
+    expert = 0  # local expert 0 == global expert 0 when EP is off
+    return (
+        name,
+        module,
+        expert,
+        w13[expert].detach().clone(),
+        s13[expert].detach().clone(),
+        w2[expert].detach().clone(),
+        s2[expert].detach().clone(),
+        topk,
+        _w13_up_first(module),
+    )
+
+
+# (layer, reason) pairs already reported, so a probe that cannot run on a layer warns once, not every sync.
+_WARNED: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
+
+
+def _warn_skip(name: str, reason: str) -> None:
+    """Warn, once per layer and reason, that the expert probe cannot run on this layer."""
+    if (name, reason) not in _WARNED:
+        _WARNED.add((name, reason))
+        logger.warning("mxfp8 MoE refit check skipped on %s (sglang): %s", name, reason)
+
+
+# Routing the probe's logits steer exactly: softmax over experts, then (Renormalize) or before (Default /
+# RenormalizeNaive) the top-k. With logit 0 for the probed expert and _PROBE_OTHER_LOGIT for every other one, the
+# probed expert gets weight 1.0 and the others exactly 0 in every case.
+_PROBE_ROUTING_METHODS = ("Default", "Renormalize", "RenormalizeNaive")
+_PROBE_OTHER_LOGIT = -1.0e4
+
+
+def _find_topk_module(model: torch.nn.Module, name: str):
+    """The sglang ``TopK`` that routes for the fused-MoE layer ``name``: its one sibling of that type (``mlp.topk``)."""
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import TopK
+
+    parent = model.get_submodule(name.rpartition(".")[0])
+    found = [m for m in parent.children() if isinstance(m, TopK)]
+    return found[0] if len(found) == 1 else None
+
+
+def _probe_routing_problem(module: torch.nn.Module, topk) -> str | None:
+    """Why the probe's logits cannot route every row to one expert at weight 1 on this layer, or None if they can."""
+    if topk is None:
+        return "no single sglang TopK module next to the experts"
+    cfg = topk.topk_config
+    if getattr(cfg, "scoring_func", "softmax") != "softmax":
+        return f"{cfg.scoring_func} scoring"
+    if cfg.use_grouped_topk or cfg.correction_bias is not None or cfg.custom_routing_function is not None:
+        return "grouped, biased or custom top-k routing"
+    if cfg.num_fused_shared_experts:
+        return "shared experts fused into the routed ones"
+    runner_cfg = getattr(module, "moe_runner_config", None)
+    for factor in (cfg.routed_scaling_factor, getattr(runner_cfg, "routed_scaling_factor", None)):
+        if factor not in (None, 1.0):
+            return f"routed scaling factor {factor}"
+    if getattr(module, "use_flashinfer_trtllm_moe", False):
+        # FlashInfer TRT-LLM routes inside the kernel by the layer's routing method; Fp8MoEMethod passes an unset
+        # (or Default == 0) method as DeepSeekV3.
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import RoutingMethodType
+
+        method = getattr(module, "routing_method_type", None)
+        method = RoutingMethodType(int(method)).name if method else "DeepSeekV3"
+        if method not in _PROBE_ROUTING_METHODS:
+            return f"FlashInfer TRT-LLM routing method {method}"
+    return None
+
+
+def _w13_up_first(module: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
+    """Whether sglang stores this layer's ``w13`` as ``[up; gate]`` rather than ``[gate; up]``.
+
+    ``FusedMoE`` swaps the w1 / w3 shard ids at load on the FlashInfer TRT-LLM runners ("Flashinfer assumes w31
+    format", sglang 0.5.12 to 0.5.20) for ``Fp8MoEMethod``, and ``_load_w13`` puts up first for quant methods with
+    ``load_up_proj_weight_first``; both together cancel.
+    """
+    return bool(getattr(module, "use_flashinfer_trtllm_moe", False)) != bool(
+        getattr(module.quant_method, "load_up_proj_weight_first", False)
+    )
+
+
+def _route_everything_to(module: torch.nn.Module, expert: int, topk: torch.nn.Module):
+    """Return ``apply_fn(x)`` running the MoE layer as the model does, with every row routed to ``expert`` at weight 1.

+    Only the router logits are made up (0 for ``expert``, ``_PROBE_OTHER_LOGIT`` for every other one): the model's
+    own ``TopK`` turns them into what the layer's runner consumes — the logits themselves for FlashInfer TRT-LLM,
+    which routes inside the kernel, a precomputed top-k for the others — so the probe takes the routing path of
+    generation. With ``top_k > 1`` other experts are selected too, at weight exactly 0.
+    """

+"""Export vs engine on SGLang: the parameter that receives each synced HF weight.
+
+The check itself is ``verl.utils.quant_sync_format_check.SyncFormatCheck``. The MXFP8/MXFP4/NVFP4 refit loader
+(``verl.utils.sglang.sglang_quant_utils.load_and_reprocess``) calls it: ``begin_sync`` on the first request of a
+sync, ``check_bucket`` before each bucket is loaded and ``end_sync`` after the kernel layouts are re-derived.
+Formats SGLang loads without that loader (FP8 blockwise) are not checked.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from verl.utils.quant_sync_format_check import SyncFormatCheck
+
+# HF projections SGLang fuses into one module (the model's stacked_params_mapping, restated).
+_STACKED = {
+    "q_proj": "qkv_proj",
+    "k_proj": "qkv_proj",
+    "v_proj": "qkv_proj",
+    "gate_proj": "gate_up_proj",
+    "up_proj": "gate_up_proj",
+}
+_W2_LEAVES = ("down_proj", "w2")
+_PARAM_LEAVES = ("weight", "weight_packed")
+
+
+def resolve_sglang_param(model: torch.nn.Module, hf_name: str) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    """The SGLang parameter that receives HF weight ``hf_name``, or ``None`` when the name does not resolve.
+
+    Walks the module tree by name, trying the fused module name for projections SGLang stacks
+    (``q_proj`` -> ``qkv_proj``, ``gate_proj`` -> ``gate_up_proj``) and stopping at a fused-MoE block
+    (a module holding ``w13_weight``), where the remaining per-expert parts select ``w13`` or ``w2``.
+    A packed FP4 ``.weight_packed`` lands in the module's ``weight_packed``, or in ``weight`` on a layer
+    the engine keeps in BF16.
+    """
+    parts = hf_name.split(".")
+    leaf = parts[-1] if parts[-1] in _PARAM_LEAVES else None
+    module_path = parts[:-1] if leaf else parts
+    cur: object = model
+    for i, part in enumerate(module_path):
+        if hasattr(cur, "w13_weight"):
+            return cur.w2_weight if any(r in _W2_LEAVES for r in module_path[i:]) else cur.w13_weight
+        nxt = getattr(cur, part, None)
+        if nxt is None and part in _STACKED:
+            nxt = getattr(cur, _STACKED[part], None)
+        if nxt is None:
+            return None
+        cur = nxt
+    if hasattr(cur, "w13_weight"):
+        return cur.w2_weight if parts[-1] in _W2_LEAVES else cur.w13_weight
+    if isinstance(cur, torch.nn.Module):
+        for attr in ("weight_packed", "weight") if leaf == "weight_packed" else ("weight",):
+            param = getattr(cur, attr, None)
+            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
+                return param
+        return None
+    return cur if isinstance(cur, torch.Tensor) else None
+
+
+def sglang_sync_format_check(model: torch.nn.Module) -> SyncFormatCheck:
+    """The export-vs-engine check of an SGLang model."""
+    return SyncFormatCheck.of(model, "sglang", resolve_sglang_param)

+"""Post-sync self-check for vLLM's compressed-tensors MXFP8 layers.
+
+``process_quanted_weights_after_loading`` re-derives each staged layer's kernel
+layout from the canonical tensors a weight sync wrote. Before that step, the
+snapshot functions copy the canonical weight and scale of the smallest MXFP8
+linear layer (``CompressedTensorsLinearMethod`` with the
+``CompressedTensorsW8A8Mxfp8`` scheme) and of one expert of the smallest MXFP8
+MoE layer (``CompressedTensorsW8A8Mxfp8MoEMethod``); after it, the check
+functions run those layers through their own kernels and compare the output
+with the dequantized reference (``verl.utils.mxfp8_refit_check``). A kernel copy
+that did not follow the sync is reported (``VERL_MXFP8_REFIT_CHECK=raise`` stops the
+sync) instead of serving the old weights silently.
+
+The probes run eagerly, so storage that a CUDA graph captured is not checked.
+``VERL_MXFP8_REFIT_CHECK=0`` disables both checks.
+"""
+
+import logging
+import os
+
+import torch
+
+from verl.utils.mxfp8_refit_check import (
+    MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE,
+    assert_mxfp8_linear_matches,
+    assert_mxfp8_moe_expert_matches,
+    refit_check_enabled,
+)
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "WARN"))
+
+_WARNED: set[str] = set()
+
+
+def _warn_once(key: str, msg: str, *args) -> None:
+    if key not in _WARNED:
+        _WARNED.add(key)
+        logger.warning(msg, *args)
+
+
+def _is_canonical_scale(weight: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    """uint8 E8M0 scale of shape ``[..., N, K // 32]`` for a ``[..., N, K]`` weight: the layout the sync writes."""
+    return (
+        scale.dtype == torch.uint8
+        and scale.ndim == weight.ndim
+        and tuple(scale.shape) == (*weight.shape[:-1], weight.shape[-1] // MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE)
+    )
+
+
+def _is_mxfp8_linear(module) -> bool:
+    return (
+        type(getattr(module, "quant_method", None)).__name__ == "CompressedTensorsLinearMethod"
+        and type(getattr(module, "scheme", None)).__name__ == "CompressedTensorsW8A8Mxfp8"
+        and isinstance(getattr(module, "weight", None), torch.Tensor)
+        and isinstance(getattr(module, "weight_scale", None), torch.Tensor)
+    )
+
+
+def snapshot_mxfp8_linear_for_check(model):
+    """Copy the canonical weight and scale of the smallest MXFP8 linear layer.
+
+    Must run after ``load_weights`` and before the staged layers are re-processed:
+    at that point ``weight_scale`` is the canonical uint8 ``[N, K // 32]`` tensor
+    the sync just wrote, which the kernel post-processing may then rewrite.
+    """
+    if not refit_check_enabled():
+        return None
+    found = 0
+    best = None
+    for name, module in model.named_modules():
+        if not _is_mxfp8_linear(module):
+            continue
+        found += 1
+        if module.weight.ndim != 2 or not _is_canonical_scale(module.weight, module.weight_scale):
+            continue  # kernel layout already applied: cannot serve as the reference
+        if best is None or module.weight.numel() < best[1].weight.numel():
+            best = (name, module)
+    if best is None:
+        if found:
+            _warn_once(
+                "linear",
+                "mxfp8 refit self-check skipped: none of the %d compressed-tensors MXFP8 linear layers holds a "
+                "canonical uint8 [N, K/32] scale after the weight sync, so there is no reference for the kernel",
+                found,
+            )
+        return None
+    name, module = best
+    return name, module, module.weight.data.detach().clone(), module.weight_scale.data.detach().clone()
+
+
+def self_check_mxfp8_linear(snapshot) -> None:
+    if snapshot is None:
+        return
+    name, module, qweight, scale = snapshot
+    qm = module.quant_method
+    assert_mxfp8_linear_matches(name, lambda x: qm.apply(module, x), qweight, scale, engine="vllm")
+
+
+def _is_mxfp8_moe(module) -> bool:
+    return type(getattr(module, "quant_method", None)).__name__ == "CompressedTensorsW8A8Mxfp8MoEMethod" and all(
+        isinstance(getattr(module, n, None), torch.Tensor)
+        for n in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight", "w13_weight_scale", "w2_weight_scale")
+    )
+
+
+def _moe_parallel(module):
+    """(tp_size, ep_size, dp_size) of a vLLM RoutedExperts / FusedMoE module, defaulting to 1."""
+    pc = getattr(getattr(module, "moe_config", None), "moe_parallel_config", None)
+    tp = int(getattr(pc, "tp_size", 1) or 1)
+    ep = int(getattr(pc, "ep_size", 1) or 1)
+    if getattr(pc, "use_ep", False):
+        ep = max(ep, 2)
+    dp = int(getattr(pc, "dp_size", 1) or 1)
+    return tp, ep, dp
+
+
+def snapshot_mxfp8_moe_for_check(model):
+    """Copy one local expert's canonical weights and scales from the smallest MXFP8 MoE layer.
+
+    Must run after ``load_weights`` and before the staged layers are re-processed,
+    while ``w13_weight_scale`` / ``w2_weight_scale`` are the canonical
+    ``[E, N, K // 32]`` uint8 tensors the sync just wrote. Returns ``None`` when the
+    check is disabled, no layer qualifies, or the layer's parallelism or activation
+    is one the probe cannot reproduce (expert or data parallelism, non-SiLU gating);
+    a layer skipped for a reason is reported once.
+    """
+    if not refit_check_enabled():
+        return None
+    best = None
+    for name, module in model.named_modules():
+        if not _is_mxfp8_moe(module):
+            continue
+        if best is None or module.w13_weight.numel() < best[1].w13_weight.numel():
+            best = (name, module)
+    if best is None:
+        return None
+    name, module = best
+    tp, ep, dp = _moe_parallel(module)
+    if ep > 1 or dp > 1:
+        _warn_once(
+            f"moe-parallel:{name}",
+            "mxfp8 MoE refit check skipped on %s (vllm): expert or data parallelism (ep_size=%d, dp_size=%d); the "
+            "probe routes every row to local expert 0, which is global expert 0 only without them",
+            name,
+            ep,
+            dp,
+        )
+        return None
+    act = getattr(module, "activation", None)
+    if act is not None and "silu" not in str(getattr(act, "value", act)).lower():
+        _warn_once(
+            f"moe-activation:{name}",
+            "mxfp8 MoE refit check skipped on %s (vllm): activation %s; the reference implements the SiLU-gated "
+            "MLP only",
+            name,
+            act,
+        )
+        return None
+    problem = _monolithic_routing_problem(module)
+    if problem is not None:
+        _warn_once(
+            f"moe-routing:{name}",
+            "mxfp8 MoE refit check skipped on %s (vllm): %s, which the monolithic MoE kernel applies to the probe's "
+            "router logits, so they cannot route every row to one expert at weight 1",
+            name,
+            problem,
+        )
+        return None
+    w13, w2 = module.w13_weight.data, module.w2_weight.data
+    s13, s2 = module.w13_weight_scale.data, module.w2_weight_scale.data
+    if not (_is_canonical_scale(w13, s13) and _is_canonical_scale(w2, s2)):
+        _warn_once(
+            "moe",
+            "mxfp8 MoE refit self-check skipped on %s: its expert scales are not the canonical uint8 "
+            "[E, N, K/32] tensors after the weight sync, so there is no reference for the kernel",
+            name,
+        )
+        return None
+    expert = 0  # local expert 0 == global expert 0 without EP
+    return (
+        name,
+        module,
+        expert,
+        w13[expert].detach().clone(),
+        s13[expert].detach().clone(),
+        w2[expert].detach().clone(),
+        s2[expert].detach().clone(),
+    )
+
+
+def _monolithic_routing_problem(module) -> str | None:
+    """Why made-up router logits cannot pin one expert at weight 1 through this layer's kernel, or None.
+
+    A monolithic kernel (``CompressedTensorsW8A8Mxfp8MoEMethod.apply_monolithic``) routes inside the kernel and
+    receives the layer's routing parameters with the logits: ``routed_scaling_factor`` scales the output, and
+    grouped top-k, a score correction bias or a custom routing function change which experts the logits select.
+    A modular kernel takes the hand-built top-k and never sees them.
+    """
+    if not getattr(getattr(module, "quant_method", None), "is_monolithic", False):
+        return None
+    factor = getattr(module, "routed_scaling_factor", None)
+    if factor not in (None, 1, 1.0):
+        return f"routed scaling factor {factor}"
+    if getattr(module, "use_grouped_topk", False) or (getattr(module, "num_expert_group", None) or 1) > 1:
+        return "grouped top-k routing"
+    if getattr(module, "e_score_correction_bias", None) is not None:
+        return "a score correction bias"
+    if getattr(module, "custom_routing_function", None) is not None:
+        return "a custom routing function"
+    return None
+
+
+def _route_everything_to_vllm_expert(module, expert: int):
+    """``apply_fn(x)`` running the RoutedExperts module with every row routed to ``expert`` at weight 1.
+
+    Calls the weight holder directly, past the MoERunner (router, shared experts, final all-reduce):
+    ``forward_modular`` with a hand-built top-k for modular kernels, which also bypasses the layer's
+    ``routed_scaling_factor``; ``forward_monolithic`` with a one-hot-dominant logit row for monolithic
+    ones, whose kernel still applies the layer's routing parameters (see ``_monolithic_routing_problem``,
+    which keeps the probe off the layers where they matter).
+    """
+
+    def _apply(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if hasattr(module, "_ensure_moe_quant_config_init"):
+            module._ensure_moe_quant_config_init()
+        qm = module.quant_method
+        rows = x.shape[0]
+        n_experts = module.w13_weight.shape[0]
+        if getattr(qm, "is_monolithic", False):
+            logits = torch.full((rows, n_experts), -1e4, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+            logits[:, expert] = 1e4  # softmax and sigmoid routers both give this expert weight 1, others 0
+            return module.forward_monolithic(x, router_logits=logits)
+        k = max(1, int(getattr(module, "top_k", 1) or 1))
+        ids = [(expert + i) % n_experts for i in range(k)]  # distinct ids; only the first carries weight
+        idx_dtype = getattr(qm, "topk_indices_dtype", None) or torch.int32
+        topk_ids = torch.tensor([ids] * rows, dtype=idx_dtype, device=x.device)
+        topk_weights = torch.zeros(rows, k, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+        topk_weights[:, 0] = 1.0
+        return module.forward_modular(x, topk_weights, topk_ids)
+
+    return _apply
+
+
+def self_check_mxfp8_moe(snapshot) -> None:
+    if snapshot is None:
+        return
+    name, module, expert, w13_q, s13, w2_q, s2 = snapshot
+    reduce_ref = None
+    tp, _, _ = _moe_parallel(module)
+    kernel = getattr(module.quant_method, "moe_kernel", None)
+    if tp > 1 and kernel is not None and getattr(kernel, "output_is_reduced", lambda: False)():
+        # The kernel already summed the TP shards; the reference (built from local shards) must too.
+        from vllm.distributed import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+
+        reduce_ref = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+    # tp > 1 without an internal reduction: forward_modular returns this rank's partial sum, which is
+    # exactly what the local-shard reference computes, so no reduction is applied.
+    assert_mxfp8_moe_expert_matches(
+        name,
+        expert,
+        _route_everything_to_vllm_expert(module, expert),
+        w13_q,
+        s13,
+        w2_q,
+        s2,
+        engine="vllm",
+        reduce_ref=reduce_ref,
+    )
